path.description: Infisical folder path, e.g. /backend. Omit for the project root.

defaultEnv.description: Environment slug or alias used when --env is not given. Defaults to dev, or the first environment if there is no dev.

environments.description: Keyed by Infisical environment slug. When set, only these environments exist. Built-in slugs (dev, test, staging, prod) fill in missing aliases/file. Defaults to all four built-ins.

file.description: Env file to write, relative to this config file
